item.title: Alberta Premier Danielle Smith seeks say in judicial appointments, threatens to withhold funds from Ottawa
item.description: In a letter sent to Carney on Jan. 23, Smith said her government wants a role in the appointment process to fill judicial vacancies in Alberta and the Supreme Court of Canada.

item.title: Opinion: Focus on Black inclusion should last more than a month
